limitations: Compiler symbol identity is an independent static-analysis oracle, not runtime behavioral proof.
Scopes cover named exported definitions in two pinned production trees; anonymous exports and dynamic dispatch are not covered.
Oracle labels omit type-only occurrences; import/reexport binding occurrences count as runtime linkage evidence.
The AST tool returns syntactic candidates, which an LLM can inspect; false-positive candidates are not false exactness claims.

Baseline requests use its existing 80-result cap; truncation metadata is retained. Graph predictions use stored resolved edges. This is information retrieval analysis, not a resource-matched agent tool-call comparison.
An empty graph prediction is not a proof of no dependencies; missing/unparsed definitions are explicitly reported.
No foundation model is used to construct or score these labels.
